name: legendaryplugin
description: LegendaryPlugin Pro - Enterprise Paper 1.21.x plugin (Anti-Cheat with ML, Anti-ESP, Optimization, Verification, Replay, Anti-RE, Anti-DDoS)

scripts.build: python3 src/test/simulation/anticheat_simulation.py && python3 src/test/simulation/player_simulation.py && mkdir -p dist && cp src/main/resources/plugin.yml dist/ && cp -r public/* dist/ 2>/dev/null; node generate-landing.js && echo 'Build verification passed'
scripts.dev: echo 'This is a Java/Maven project. Use mvn clean package to build the JAR. Run npm run build for verification.'
scripts.start: echo 'This is a Minecraft plugin. Build with mvn clean package and deploy the JAR to your Paper server.'
